questions.text: Jatin, Kavya and Lokesh share profits 3:2:1. Lokesh has guaranteed the firm a minimum profit of Rs. 1,80,000. Actual profit is Rs. 1,60,000; Lokesh meets the shortfall. Lokesh's net share is:
questions.explanation: base profit = max(160000,180000) = 180000 shortfall 20000 borne by Lokesh Lokesh's net share = Rs. 10,000  Correct option A. Distractors: B = shared the actual profit, not the guaranteed minimum; C = did not deduct the shortfall from the guarantor's share; D = reported only the shortfall.
